name: Grapple Rope
description: Swing like Tarzan. Hold left click to throw the hook into a brick or the map and hang on, let go to fly off with all your speed. Your movement keys pump the swing and the mouse wheel climbs up or pays out the rope. You need momentum: swing. Type /grapplerope for one. Based on the v20 Grapple Rope by Demian, SolarFlare and Uristqwerty (original code by Qwertyuiopas).
